subject.title: fix(mattermost): backfill thread history from server when in-memory window is empty

question: Should Mattermost cold-thread recovery accept one awaited fetch of up to five seconds and no retry after a failed attempt until the stored session id rotates?
rationale: Both choices affect user-visible availability and session-context recovery; source review can verify the implementation, but only the Mattermost owner can set the intended latency-versus-retry policy.

options.title: Accept bounded one-attempt recovery
options.body: Keep the current five-second bound and one-attempt-per-session behavior to prevent repeated inbound-path delays and request storms.

options.title: Add bounded transient retry
options.body: Require a cooldown or backoff state that permits later recovery after transient failure without retrying every follow-up turn.

options.title: Pause the recovery change
options.body: Leave the linked issue open until a different non-blocking recovery design is agreed.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded one-attempt recovery
recommendation.body: Keep the current five-second bound and one-attempt-per-session behavior to prevent repeated inbound-path delays and request storms.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available Mattermost ownership signal and the policy choice directly affects the channel's inbound runtime behavior.
